## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe your testing steps.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code quality / refactoring / tests

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation if needed.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] Code passes linting checks (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .`).
